turnaround_reason: Simply Good Foods fell from ~$28 to ~$11 on decelerating sales, an $82M Atkins/OWYN goodwill impairment, and the market's fear that GLP-1 weight-loss drugs structurally erode demand for its nutrition snacks. It is basing as management resets distribution and leans into a GLP-1-adjacent positioning while Quest keeps growing.
bullish_points: Cheap with real cash generation: forward P/E ~6.7, EV/EBITDA ~6.2, price/book ~0.71, FCF ~$107M and operating cash flow ~$148M
Quest brand is growing (chips and milkshakes strong) and management argues Atkins snacking overlaps heavily with GLP-1 users rather than being displaced by them
Notable open-market insider buying: director Kilts bought ~$991k and Daley ~$118k in 2026 — real conviction, not grants
Distribution cuts framed as a deliberate reset to align shelf space with demand; Atkins expected to stabilize as it laps weak comps
Strong balance sheet: current ratio ~4.8, manageable debt (D/E ~31.6), analysts rate it a buy with ~$14.4 mean target vs $11.45
bearish_points: Guidance is still deteriorating: FY26 net sales guided -7% to -6% and adjusted EBITDA -21% to -19%
$82M non-cash impairment confirms the Atkins/OWYN brands are worth less than paid; OWYN distribution losses expected to persist 6-12 months
GLP-1 is a genuine, unresolved secular question for the meal-replacement/weight-management category
Turnaround is early-stage ('strengthening economics, org clarity, rebuilding brand investment') with no proven inflection yet
Negative TTM profit margin (-14.3%) driven by impairment; growth is negative (-6.3%)
catalyst: Atkins sales stabilization as comps ease, Quest momentum, and evidence that GLP-1 users remain buyers; FY27 guidance reset
suggested_trade: Spot, small starter in the $10.50-11.50 zone alongside the insider buyers; add only when sales growth turns less negative
key_risk: GLP-1 adoption structurally shrinks the category and Atkins keeps declining, so the cheap multiple compresses further on falling EBITDA
would_skip_if: Next print shows Quest decelerating too, or FY27 guidance implies continued double-digit EBITDA declines
